title: feat(flow designer): edge conditions as field rows, and an approval inserts with approve and reject edges
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgae1jRRi8FRrTxaZL

Part of #34818 (slice 2 of 3: items 3 and 4; slice 3 takes items 5 to 9 and closes the card).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 连线条件默认按「字段 / 运算符 / 值」逐行填写（用的是列表工具栏的筛选组件，原样引入），右上角一键切到「公式」。不写公式就能配出「截止日期 晚于 今天」，存下来是 `record.due_date != null && record.due_date > today()`。
- 已有的条件只有和逐行写法逐字一致时才以逐行打开；其他任何条件都以公式打开、原样不动。点「按字段填写」会说明为什么不能转。
- 引用选择器业务字段在前、平台字段（审计、租户、`id`）在后；有显示名的字段以显示名为主，内部路径做小字。
- 插入审批节点时自带两条出边：插在连线上时「通过」接原来的下一步，「驳回」接新建的「已驳回」结束节点；追加时两条分别接新建的「已通过」「已驳回」。画布上标签按界面语言显示。
- 审批缺「通过」或「驳回」出边时，「问题」页签各报一条，点击定位到该审批节点。
- 元数据结构、引擎行为、发布检查都不变。审批说明文字里「给出边打标签」那句，席位同意挪到第 3 片（它在 `flow-node-config.ts`，第 3 片本来就要改）。

## What changes

**Edge conditions as field rows (item 3).**
- New `inspectors/flow-edge-condition-rows.ts` bridges a guard and the `FilterBuilder`'s rows. It is imported from `@object-ui/components` and not edited.
  - `rowsToCel` writes one fixed spelling per operator. Ordering, `between` and the string methods are null-guarded (`S != null && …`), the guard the server's null-guard gate asks for (objectstack#27513). Empty checks follow the spec's `expandEmptyOperator` table in `ConditionBuilder`'s clauses. A date column's relative points become the formula stdlib's calendar calls (`{today}` → `today()`, `{yesterday}` → `daysAgo(1)`, `{tomorrow}` → `daysFromNow(1)`).
  - A finished row it cannot write faithfully is refused by id and nothing is committed: `icontains`, a datetime or time literal (`datetime-local` has no zone), a relative window on `between`, an operator the builder does not offer for the column, or a comparison on a multi-value column.
  - `celToRows` reads a stored guard back only when re-writing the rows it read gives back the same bytes. Anything else answers `null`.
- `FlowEdgeInspector.tsx` gains `EdgeConditionEditor`.
  - Rows are the default whenever the flow has a record trigger and the stored guard reads back. Otherwise the existing `VariableTextInput` formula input is shown, with the guard unchanged.
  - The switch back to rows is offered only for a guard the rows can show. For any other guard it stays a formula and says why.
  - Rows being edited are held locally, so an unfinished row stays on screen. Both modes write through `writeExpressionSource`, so a stored envelope keeps its dialect.
  - The subjects are the edge scope's own spellings (`TriggerScope.fieldPrefix` + name), by label, business fields first.

**Reference picker (item 3).**
- `flow-scope.ts`: `isPlatformField` (the served `system` flag, `id`, or the spec's `FIELD_GROUP_SYSTEM_FIELDS`) and `businessFieldsFirst`. `triggerFieldRefs` lists business fields first and gives a labelled field its label as `label`.
- `VariableTextInput.tsx`: a ref whose label differs from its token shows the label as main text, with the token muted beside it. Refs with no name of their own (variables, outputs) render as before.

**Approval outcomes (item 4).**
- `FlowCanvas.tsx`:
  - `approvalOutcomes` builds the `approve` and `reject` edges and the new end nodes.
  - `insertOnEdge` and `addNode` use it for an `approval`. Every other type inserts as before.
  - An approval's `approve` / `reject` / `revise` pills read in the designer's language, with the keyword kept in the title.
- `FlowPreview.tsx`: `mintNodeId` takes `alsoTaken`, so one gesture mints distinct ids that still respect the session ledger (#11772).
- `flow-problems.ts`: `approvalOutcomeProblems` adds one `warning` per missing `approve` / `reject` out-edge, targeted at the node. `revise` is not asked for.
- `flow-canvas-parts.tsx`: comment only.
- i18n: new `studio` keys in en and zh (edge condition modes and notes, the two end labels, the problem sentence).

## Tests

- `inspectors/flow-edge-condition-rows.test.ts` (44 tests), with the read-back pinned both ways:
  - 18 written forms round-trip;
  - 18 other stored guards read as `null`, including near misses of the writer's own spellings (unguarded ordering, extra parentheses, double quotes, spacing, a quoted number, mixed joins, `vars.*`, `previous.*`, a bare field);
  - five refusals;
  - the formula engine (`@objectstack/formula` `celEngine`) evaluates "date after today" true for tomorrow, false for yesterday and for null, and the null-guarded text and list spellings on null.
- `inspectors/FlowEdgeInspector.conditionRows-34818.test.tsx` (6 tests):
  - rows open for a guard the rows write, and Formula shows the same guard;
  - a hand-written guard opens unchanged and stays a formula;
  - an empty edge opens as rows;
  - a row edit keeps the envelope's dialect;
  - no record trigger gives the formula input only;
  - the picker lists business fields first, by label.
- `inspectors/flow-scope.test.ts`: ordering, labels, `isPlatformField`.
- `previews/FlowCanvas.approvalOutcomes-34818.test.tsx` (5 tests): insert on a connection, append, the plain-node control, ids that skip the session ledger, and the pill words with a control.
- `previews/flow-problems.approvalOutcomes-34818.test.ts` (4 tests): both missing, one missing (case and space tolerant), both present, and the control on other node types.
- Updated: `inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10748.test.tsx`.
  - Its picker cases now click Formula first, because an empty guard opens as rows.
  - Its detail case reads labelled fields by their label, with the token beside it. The words it pins are unchanged.

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to HEAD and verified):

| Mutation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `triggerFieldRefs` without `businessFieldsFirst` | 1 of 56 `flow-scope` tests red |
| `celToRows` without the byte-equality check | 4 of 44 bridge tests red (the near misses) |
| `insertOnEdge` approval branch off | 1 of 5 canvas tests red (append still uses `addNode`) |
| `approvalOutcomeProblems` not pushed | 2 of 4 problem tests red (the "nothing reported" cases stay green) |
| `VariableTextInput` label branch off | 1 of 6 edge tests red (the picker case) |
| rows mode off (`showRows = false`) | 3 of 6 edge tests red |

## Acceptance notes

- **"不写公式能配出「会议日期 晚于 今天」这样的分支条件"**:
  - live: built as rows, "截止日期 · 晚于 · 今天" on `showcase_task`, stored as `record.due_date != null && record.due_date > today()`;
  - engine: evaluated by the bridge suite.
- **"新插入的审批节点有「通过」「驳回」两条出边"**: live. The inserted approval's out-edges were `approve` to the next step and `reject` to a new 已驳回 end, and the pills read 通过 / 驳回.
- Item 4, "缺任一条时在「问题」页签报出来": live. With the reject edge removed, Problems listed 审批「审批」没有「驳回」出边… and the click selected the node.

## Verification

Measured on head `cbb82b02c` (base `e05445e4f`), on a shared box.

- Tests: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin packages/i18n` gave 850 files, 9940 passed and 14 skipped, exit 0. The same run on the previous base `d947a93cf` gave 849 files. Its one red, `inspectorStrings.i18n-10748`, is the updated file listed under Tests.
- Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both projects) exit 0. A first run failed in `AiChatPage.tsx` on `publishFromShellBar`. The cause was a `plugin-chatbot` dist built before main added that prop. After `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot build` it exits 0. No file of this PR is involved.
- Derived gates: 88 derived on base `d947a93cf`, all run.
  - 83 exited 0.
  - Two were red and are fixed in this branch. `check:test-source-alias` asked for a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` in the updated `inspectorStrings.i18n-10748` test. `check:dts-closure` reported a missing `ui/apps/console/plugin.d.ts`, local tree state left by an earlier gate's console `vite build`. After `build:plugin` it exits 0.
  - `check-partof-closing-keyword` exited 0 with this body as `PR_BODY`.
  - Two need a PR number and token, so they are left to this PR's PR-body guards: `check-closing-target-claim` and `check-single-claim-paths`.
  - After the restart on `e05445e4f`, which brought two shared studio i18n files, these were re-run with exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:i18n-stale-fill` and `check:test-source-alias`.
- Eager bundle: not measured. Every new key is in the lazy `studio` namespace, and no eager pack changed.
- Live: showcase backend (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh`), the console under Vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, and Playwright at 1280×860 with zh-CN and en. The flow is a draft on `showcase_task` (record-after-create). The readings are in the comment below, and the screenshots and script are in the seat's project files under `objectstack-seat3/34818-live/slice2/` (`zh-1`…`zh-7`, `en-1`…`en-7`).
- Not run locally, left to CI: the full ui suite, `test:repo` and the dogfood battery (no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm).
